changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_revision AS ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY model, model_id ORDER BY id )::int AS version_no FROM analytics_revision ) UPDATE analytics_revision current_revision SET version_no = COALESCE(current_revision.version_no, ranked_revision.version_no), status = COALESCE(current_revision.status, 'DRAFT') FROM ranked_revision WHERE current_revision.id = ranked_revision.id AND (current_revision.version_no IS NULL OR current_revision.status IS NULL); ALTER TABLE analytics_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_analytics_revision_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'SUPERSEDED'));

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_analytics_revision_legacy_defaults ON public.analytics_revision; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.set_analytics_revision_legacy_defaults();
ALTER TABLE analytics_revision DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_analytics_revision_status;
